entry.author: H2O.ai (paid fast-lane order 5fa1a5f0, PUBLIC visibility)
entry.code_revision: The author's documented JevBench configuration, unmodified: run_default.sh, the one-engine profile (author's README, 'how to run for JevBench'), on vLLM 0.30.0 (official vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0 image, digest-pinned) with the author's h2oai/vllm overlay at commit 6bc6d5a8 (18 patched files, sha256-checked against the pin) and the author's shim lightning_31b_shim.py; torch 2.13.0, transformers 5.20.0, torchcodec 0.17.0 hash-locked. Engine: one vLLM engine, FP8 weights (vLLM online FP8 of the bf16 checkpoint, --quantization fp8), two-way reading by default (one-way, read whole, for a record over the 8,192-token two-way window or a request over the 4,096-token latency cap); the profile's own temperatures and yes/no floor 0.801 as shipped. Static review of every author file found no network, subprocess, eval, pickle or trust_remote_code use and no branch on item text.
entry.cost_basis: ESTIMATE (*est.), base-model market reference through the frozen pricing_v15 module (sha256 a8a05890ddab2d39d1a1bd543f2b5c83842bdc70aa54766788bc89b7a8a448d7): declared base google/gemma-4-31B-it -> reference() -> google/gemma-4-31b-it, USD 0.09 per million input tokens, USD 0.34 per million output tokens (frozen price cut-off snapshot), the same reference as the other Gemma-4-31B-it rows of this board. The customer asked for the cost of the base model. Estimated, not charged, not a quote from the author or any host. Tokens as reported by the author's server usage block (the full record, 1 output token per decision for the readout). Over all 1,500 items the frozen resolve() gives USD 0.115415 per 1,000 decisions; the official cost axis uses the common 1,485-item basis (below), where the row is under the official cost cap. COMMON COST BASIS (v1.6.30): common 1,485 items, excluding the 15 longest for every row; 727,319 input / 1,485 output tokens. All-item usage 1,917,924 input / 1,500 output over 1,500 items; the 15 longest items, which this row answered in full, count for no row's cost.
entry.disclosure: MEASURED AS SHIPPED: the author's own documented JevBench configuration (run_default.sh, one-engine profile): FP8 weights and the two-way reading that this profile applies by default. A different serving choice (for example the author's stock-vLLM one-way fallback) would give different numbers. ALL 1,500 ITEMS ANSWERED IN FULL: none was refused, cut or truncated; the 15 longest items (76,497 to 81,692 input tokens, below the engine's 126,976-token cap) were read whole one-way. 15 decisions took more than 10 seconds (the 15 longest items, maximum 39.08 s); v1.6 applies no 10-second rule. PUBLIC VS SEALED, author statement: the author's README reports 214 of 231 on the public JevBench items from its own client (easy 48/48, original 72/72, hard 94/111). That figure is the author's, on the public items; this row's numbers are what we measured on the sealed draw, and the scorer's standard public-vs-sealed gap rule applies as for every row. TRAINING DATA: the author's training-data statement was not checked. Customer statements about the model, its training and its serving are not independently verified. Measured accuracy on the 15 longest items (answered in full): 7 of 15 correct (46.7 %), versus 1313 of 1485 (88.4 %) on the remaining items; a Score item is correct within half a label step.
